extras.verified_at_basis: M10G STORAGE BOX 16TB at 26.99€ monthly billing
extras.limits_verbatim: 100 Mbps sustained egress; 500 MB RAM on storage boxes; RAID5 single-parity
extras.egress_verbatim: Verbatim: "Internet egress: Unlimited@100Mbps (~30TB/Month / ~1TB/Day)" + "Burst egress: 10Gbps 500GiB/month" + "Ingress: Unlimited at 10Gbps". Genuinely unmetered, rate-shaped at 100 Mbps sustained (~1 TiB/day). Not a byte cap.
extras.chaining_verbatim: SSHFS/rclone mount -> AList/OpenList -> Cloudflare in front for the fetch workload. 100 Mbps sustained suits 500 GB-1 TiB/day serving.
extras.tooling_verbatim: rclone native, restic/borg native, plain SSHFS mount — no S3 endpoint
extras.interface_verbatim: SSH, SCP, SFTP, FTP(S), HTTPS, public HTTP(S), SSHFS, Rsync, Rclone, Restic, Borg, Docker (rootless), WireGuard/OpenVPN
extras.agent_focus: Wave 7 cheap-paid lane: seedboxes and storage-specific hosts as bulk storage (not seeding). Price floor per TB-month with free/unmetered egress. Feral, Ultra.cc, Whatbox, PulsedMedia, SeedHost.eu, Bytesized, Seedbox.io/HostingByDesign, Hostsailor, RapidSeedbox, Dediseedbox, Xirvik, plus storage-only rsync.net, BorgBase, Tuxis, Greenhost, Njalla, Hetzner Storage Share/Box, Icedrive, FileLu.
extras.duplicate_note: The same 16 TB tier of one product line. The vendor page read 2026-10-22 lists four tiers under one name, 'M10G STORAGE BOX 4TB / 8TB / 16TB / 32TB', at EUR 8.99 / 14.99 / 26.99 / 63.99, all on the same 500 MB RAM, 10 Gbps, RAID5 platform. There is no second 16 TB SKU and no non-16 TB record of this product. The canonical record is pulsedmedia-m10g-storage-box: same product, rung documented rather than reported, and it carries the port limit this record also names. Kept rather than deleted because the dossier rule forbids deletion, and every fact in it is preserved and readable.
